uk.text: Reception → Year 4: ELG: The Natural World (changing states of matter); Year 4 – States of matter (materials change state when heated or cooled)

eu.text: Competence in science – basic principles of the natural world and scientific concepts (2018 Key competence 3B)

ie.text: Sound: identify sources of sound; vibrations, volume (Stage 2). Light: natural and artificial sources of light (Stage 3). Stage 1 covers sources and forms of energy and magnetism

uk.text: Years 3–4: Year 3 – Light (we need light in order to see things); Year 4 – Sound (sounds are made by something vibrating)

eu.text: Competence in science – basic principles of the natural world and scientific concepts (2018 Key competence 3B)

ie.text: Begin to investigate how materials may be changed by mixing: mixing paints to make new colours (1st & 2nd class)

uk.text: Reception: ELG: Creating with Materials (experimenting with colour, design, texture, form and function) – art, not science

eu.text: Competence in science – basic principles of the natural world and scientific concepts (2018 Key competence 3B)

ie.text: Using evidence and reasoning to justify decisions, support arguments and draw conclusions (element example)

uk.text: Years 5–6: Upper KS2 Working scientifically (reporting conclusions and causal relationships; identifying evidence that supports or refutes ideas)

eu.text: Competence in science – draw evidence-based conclusions (2018 Key competence 3B)
